warning_source: Institute for National Security Studies (INSS); Prof. Manuel Trajtenberg; Maj. Gen. (res.) Tamir Hayman and research team
warning_summary: INSS's Strategic Assessment for Israel 2023 identified the Palestinian arena as the immediate ignition danger, warning that rising West Bank violence could escalate into an armed intifada amid weakening PA control, Hamas strengthening in Gaza and internal-security deterioration.
evidence_update: Primary contemporaneous INSS event record directly documents that the research team submitted the assessment to Herzog in his office on 23 Jan 2023; N12 independently reported the same-day presentation and warning content. Notion entry created as WARN-116; High confidence; direct documented receipt.
gaps: Scope limitation: not a Hamas/Gaza attack warning. Herzog is a senior state recipient but not part of the executive security chain; no evidence this January presentation itself reached Netanyahu/cabinet/IDF chief or triggered an operational measure.

warning_summary: First-ever INSS strategic alert warned continuation of the judicial overhaul would degrade IDF spirit and operational capabilities, weaken national resilience, reduce Israel's ability to face enemies and damage U.S. support.
evidence_update: Primary contemporaneous INSS publication recovered and independently corroborated by Times of Israel. The warning content is strongly established.
gaps: Need direct documented transmission/receipt by a qualifying government or senior state/security decision-maker before acceptance; public publication alone is insufficient.

warning_summary: INSS urgent alert warned the people's-army model was at risk of dissolution, potentially weakening the military and jeopardizing the regional deterrence equation amid escalating threats on multiple fronts.
evidence_update: Primary contemporaneous INSS policy paper recovered; it explicitly references the March alert and says the warned deterioration had largely materialized.
gaps: Need direct receipt/transmission evidence to a qualifying official; no named recipient established in this run.

warning_source: Jerusalem Institute for Strategy and Security (JISS)
recipient: Political leadership generally addressed; named direct recipient not documented
warning_summary: JISS warned that Israel appeared externally divided and increasingly unable to function, enemies were gaining confidence, deterioration to broader conflict was substantially more likely and Israel should prepare for a tangible possibility of war, potentially multi-front.
evidence_update: Primary contemporaneous JISS statement recovered; contemporaneous Times of Israel independently reproduced the warning and characterized JISS as a conservative/hawkish security think tank.
gaps: No direct delivery to Netanyahu, cabinet or named senior security recipient found; keep below acceptance threshold.

warning_source: Yigal Carmon — MEMRI president, former military-intelligence officer and former counterterrorism adviser
warning_summary: Carmon published 'Signs of Possible War in September-October,' identifying open-source indicators of possible regional war during the exact September–October window.
evidence_update: Exact MEMRI primary URL was identified (site blocks crawler with 403); ANSA and later Davar reporting independently confirm the 31 Aug article, title, timing and core assessment. Carmon later clarified he had not specifically predicted a surprise Hamas assault and focused mainly on broader regional indicators.
gaps: Need contemporaneous evidence that this warning was actually delivered to a member of the serving government or a senior state/security decision-maker. Do not infer receipt from publication.

warning_source: Amos Yadlin — former MI chief / strategic analyst
warning_summary: Yadlin publicly warned that all alarm sirens were sounding as internal weakening interacted with external security threats.
evidence_update: Contemporaneous N12 authored column located; no reliable evidence found in this pass of a private/direct warning to Netanyahu or another qualifying decision-maker.
gaps: Need named recipient and receipt evidence. Public commentary alone remains below threshold.

warning_source: Yaakov Amidror — former NSC chief / security analyst
warning_summary: Amidror publicly said war was much closer than peace amid growing Iranian confidence and regional escalation, and urged preparation for possible war.
evidence_update: Contemporaneous Times of Israel/JNS reporting confirms the warning. No evidence found that the Apr. 13 warning was delivered directly to Netanyahu or another qualifying serving official.
gaps: Need direct recipient/receipt evidence; retain as public expert warning candidate only.
